name: Cedar Woods Properties Limited
summary: Cedar Woods Properties Limited develops and invests in properties in Australia. It engages in the acquisition, development, marketing, and sale of housing lots, apartments, townhouses, and commercial properties in Western Australia, South Australia, Victoria, and Queensland. The company also offers house-and-land packages, workplaces, master planned communities, residential communities, and community housing developments; and provides project planning, community development, land development, and property acquisition services. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in West Perth, Australia.
